name: Five Words Only Insiders Use
why_it_works: Insider vocabulary signals belonging. Teaching outsiders the words makes them feel let in, and makes insiders proud and eager to share or correct you in the comments. {{brand}} becomes the gatekeeper who opens the gate.

hook.pattern: Promise the secret language of a scene, and hint the viewer will sound like a local after.
examples: Five words you'll only hear inside a {{scene}}.
If you know word number five, you're one of us.
Say these at a {{scene}} and people will think you're a regular.

craft.notes: Order the words from easiest to deepest cut, so insiders nod along early and outsiders feel the payoff at the end. The last word is framed as a membership test, which drives comments from insiders adding words you left out.

do_not: Use slang that belongs to a culture the brand is not part of
Define a word wrong; insiders will correct you publicly and not kindly
Include words with offensive or gang-related meanings
